subject: Information Technology
text: 'Listening skill is one of the most important skills in communication.' Mention any two points to support this statement.
modelAnswer: (1) Listening ensures accurate understanding: Attentive listening allows the receiver to fully comprehend the message being communicated, reducing misunderstandings and errors in the communication process. (2) Listening builds trust and relationships: When we listen actively and empathetically, it signals respect for the speaker, strengthening interpersonal relationships and creating a positive communicative environment.
keyPoints: Ensures accurate understanding and reduces miscommunication
Builds trust, respect, and positive relationships

subject: Information Technology
text: Mention the steps to start LibreOffice Calc in Windows Operating System.
modelAnswer: Steps to start LibreOffice Calc in Windows: (1) Click the Start button (Windows icon) on the taskbar. (2) Search for 'LibreOffice Calc' in the search bar, or navigate through All Programs → LibreOffice → LibreOffice Calc. (3) Click on LibreOffice Calc to open the spreadsheet application. Alternatively, double-click a LibreOffice Calc file (.ods or .xlsx) to open it directly.
keyPoints: Click Start / search for LibreOffice Calc
Navigate to or click LibreOffice Calc to launch

subject: Information Technology
text: Define green jobs and state any one benefit of green jobs.
modelAnswer: Green Jobs: Jobs that contribute to preserving or restoring the quality of the environment — in sectors such as renewable energy (solar, wind), energy efficiency, sustainable agriculture, waste management and environmental conservation. These jobs meet the demands of a sustainable economy while reducing harm to the environment. Benefit: Green jobs promote environmental sustainability by reducing pollution and carbon emissions, helping combat climate change while also creating employment opportunities in growing sectors.
keyPoints: Benefit: reduces pollution/carbon emissions, promotes sustainability

text: Write two benefits of having a positive attitude.

(2) Better relationships and teamwork: People with positive attitudes tend to be more cooperative, motivating and pleasant to work with, leading to stronger interpersonal relationships and productive teamwork.

subject: Information Technology
text: Write one similarity and one difference between CHAR and VARCHAR data types in SQL.
modelAnswer: Similarity: Both CHAR and VARCHAR are character/string data types in SQL used to store alphanumeric text values. Difference: CHAR(n) stores a fixed-length string — it always occupies exactly n characters, padding with spaces if the actual value is shorter. VARCHAR(n) stores a variable-length string — it occupies only the space needed for the actual value (up to a maximum of n characters), making it more space-efficient for varying-length data.
keyPoints: Difference: CHAR is fixed-length (padded); VARCHAR is variable-length (no padding)

subject: Information Technology
text: Mention any two uses of database management systems in the banking sector.
modelAnswer: (1) Account management: Banks use DBMS to store and manage customer account information — account number, balance, transaction history, personal details — enabling real-time access and updates for withdrawals, deposits and transfers. (2) Loan and credit management: DBMS tracks loan applications, repayment schedules, credit scores and outstanding dues, helping bank staff manage credit efficiently and generate reports for regulatory compliance.
keyPoints: Account management: storing transaction history and balances
Loan/credit management: tracking repayments and credit data

(b) Primary Key: A primary key is a column or a combination of columns in a relational table whose values uniquely identify each tuple (row) in the table. A primary key must be unique (no two rows can have the same value) and cannot be NULL.

text: Write any two advantages of using an Online Reservation System and mention any two precautions that should be taken while performing Online Transactions.
modelAnswer:
Advantages of Online Reservation System: (1) Convenience and 24/7 availability: Users can book tickets, hotels or appointments from anywhere at any time without physically visiting offices, saving time and effort. (2) Instant confirmation and reduced errors: The system generates immediate booking confirmations and reduces human errors associated with manual booking, while also providing digital records for future reference.

Precautions for Online Transactions: (1) Use secure, trusted websites: Always ensure the website uses HTTPS (look for the padlock icon) and is an official/verified platform before entering payment details. (2) Never share OTP, PIN or password: One-Time Passwords, PINs and account passwords should never be shared with anyone — legitimate service providers will never ask for these via call, SMS or email.
keyPoints: Precautions: use HTTPS/trusted sites; never share OTP/PIN

subject: Information Technology
text: Explain the following terms in the context of Java: (a) Class (b) Exception (c) Array (d) Constructor
modelAnswer:
(a) Class: A class is a blueprint or template that defines the structure (attributes/data members) and behaviour (methods) of objects. It is the fundamental unit of object-oriented programming in Java. Example: class Car { int speed; void drive() { } }
(b) Exception: An exception is an event that disrupts the normal flow of a program during execution (runtime error), such as dividing by zero or accessing an array out of bounds. Java provides try-catch-finally blocks to handle exceptions gracefully.
(c) Array: An array is a collection of elements of the same data type stored in contiguous memory locations and accessed using an index (starting from 0). Example: int[] marks = new int[5]; stores 5 integers.
(d) Constructor: A constructor is a special method in Java that has the same name as the class and no return type. It is automatically called when an object of the class is created, and is used to initialise the object's data members.
keyPoints: Class: blueprint for objects with attributes and methods
Exception: runtime error disrupting normal program flow
Array: fixed-size collection of same-type elements with index access
Constructor: special method called at object creation to initialise it
